The main takeaway from our work is that
unsaturated FFAA are not a panacea for all GABA receptor systems.

unsaturated FFASs are not just a general modulators of membrane bound GABA/benzodiapine receptors but that their action on the receptor depends on the phylogenetic species and on the type of GABA/benzodiazepepine receptors.

the enhancement of benzodiazepine binding by unsaturated FFAs is not due to an unspecific effect of the fatty acids on the binding assay but is due to a specific interaction with the GABA/benzodiaze‐ pine receptor complex.
